## speed-sol2-small: intern hit 1.7x its bound: the second mix of the hash (solver-sync speed-of-light section 1, item 2)

- Where: `crates/hir-ty/src/next_solver/interner.rs` ~3504, `hash_of`: Fx hash then murmur's 64-bit finalizer.
- Why: the finalizer is ~8 of the hit's ~41 cycles (bound ~24). Fx's high bits are well mixed, its low bits are not.
- Change: take the shard from bits 58..63 and the slot from bits 26..57 of the plain Fx hash; drop the finalizer. First check the slot spread on real types: a test that interns the corpus's types (or the hir-ty test fixtures' types) and asserts the mean probe length stays within 10% of today's.
- With item 1 (00149, reserved column bases) the hit is ~26 cycles, within 10%.
